context: Evaluates knowledge of spprof's documented error conditions. The candidate must trigger and correctly catch ValueError (bad interval), RuntimeError (double start or stop-without-start), and PermissionError (unwritable output path).

checklist.name: ValueError on bad interval
checklist.description: Triggers spprof.start(interval_ms=0) or interval_ms < 1 and catches the resulting ValueError.

checklist.name: RuntimeError on double start
checklist.description: Calls start() twice without stop() and catches the RuntimeError raised on the second call. Cleans up (calls stop()) afterwards.

checklist.name: RuntimeError on stop-without-start
checklist.description: Calls stop() when the profiler is not running and catches the RuntimeError.

checklist.name: PermissionError on unwritable path
checklist.description: Calls start(output_path=<unwritable_path>) and catches the PermissionError raised when the path cannot be written.

checklist.name: Clean error messages
checklist.description: Prints a meaningful confirmation message for each caught error to confirm the error type was correctly identified.
